question: The famous novel 'Ananda Math' was originally written in _______________ language.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ananda math is a Bengali fiction, written by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.**
 
• Ananda math was published in **1882**.
 
• It is inspired by and set in the background of the Sannyasi Rebellion in the late 18th century, it is considered one of the most important novels in the history of Bengali and Indian literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ananda math was published in English in year 2005, 1941, 1906.**
 
• A Hindu “Santana”( who were not true sanyasis but common people who took the symbol of sanyasis and left their household so as to rebel against the **British east india company**), Jiban took the daughter to his home handing her to his sister while he shifted Kalyani to his ashram.
 
• Anand Math is **a 1952 Indian Hindi-language historical drama film directed by Hemen Gupta, based on the famous Bengali novel Anandamath.**
